subject: general
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the given set of classes.

Cobbler, Man, Shoe, Footwear
solution:
The diagram that best represents the relationship between the given set of classes is shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ef8df8d1a3750a1166dd8f40d1fead176e8755352b1f20586ccdee991194bda.png] 

Cobbler is a subset of Man (as a cobbler is a type of person).

Shoe is a subset of Footwear.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Cobbler: A person (usually a man or woman) who repairs or makes shoes and other types of footwear. A cobbler is a subset of Man (assuming humans are referred to here).

Man: Refers to humans (or male individuals) in general, which includes cobblers but not shoes or footwear.

Shoe: A specific type of Footwear, so Shoe is a subset of Footwear.

Footwear: A broader category that includes all types of footwear, such as shoes, sandals, boots, etc.
